scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc && cp src/manifest.json src/popup.html src/popup.css dist/ && mkdir -p dist/icons && cp src/icons/icon-*.png dist/icons/
scripts.package: npm run build && mkdir -p release && VERSION=$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") && rm -f "release/tablifeboat-$VERSION.zip" && (cd dist && zip -rq -X "../release/tablifeboat-$VERSION.zip" .)
scripts.test:durability: npm run build && playwright test tests/browser/recovery-durability.spec.ts
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:browser
